## SHA-3

At this pin `admin/bench-report` reports SHA3-256 and SHA3-512, and rind's Keccak rewrite (88ff91fd) closes the gap the 99b509a set recorded outside the report (2.1x libcrux's time at 16KB; `diag/esp32s3-99b509a-80mhz-2026-11-12/`). At 16KB, cycles per byte: SHA3-256 rind 151.0, libcrux 158.2, RustCrypto 273.4; SHA3-384 196.0 / 223.2 / 355.8; SHA3-512 281.2 / 319.9 / 511.6. At 64B rind takes at most 1.07x libcrux's time. For scale, CycloneCRYPTO publishes ~218 c/B (1.10 MB/s) for software SHA3-256 on this chip.

## Short inputs across relinks

`diag/esp32s3-relink-98568332/relink-short.md` runs seven of the benches in two more layouts (rind-bench's `--pad 1031` and `--pad 2053`, three runs each) and gives each short-input row's ratio in all three layouts and from the medians over layouts. Most rows move by under 0.1; rind's one-shot SHA-256 at 64B moves most, 2.36x to 3.55x libcrux's time (2.78x from the layout medians), and the AES-GCM 32B rows 0.53x-0.66x here against 0.58x-0.77x in both other layouts. Read the table above's short-input ratios with those ranges.
